faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz suitable for 20kHz cylindrical ultrasonic welding horn (sonotrode)?
faq.a: Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address ultrasonic tooling operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for 20khz cylindrical ultrasonic requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. 20khz cylindrical ultrasonic components require DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for 20khz cylindrical ultrasonic application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet 20khz cylindrical ultrasonic specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
